info.title: slack (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Simulated slack API for benchmarking. Derived from public documentation; no live service is called.

get.summary: Fetch all conversations in a Slack workspace, paginated and limited by the token's granted scopes.
get.description: Fetch all conversations in a Slack workspace, paginated and limited by the token's granted scopes.

parameters.name: exclude_archived
parameters.description: If true, archived conversations are excluded from results (default false).

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated channel type filter: public_channel, private_channel, mpim, im (default 'public_channel').

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items per page (hard max 1000, recommended 200 or fewer).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor taken from response_metadata.next_cursor.

parameters.name: team_id
parameters.description: Workspace ID, required only when using an org-level token.

get.summary: Fetch details about a specific conversation. Returns a channel object including topic, purpose, member count, and archiv
get.description: Fetch details about a specific conversation. Returns a channel object including topic, purpose, member count, and archive status.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: ID of the conversation to look up.

parameters.name: include_locale
parameters.description: Set true to include the locale for this conversation (default false).

parameters.name: include_num_members
parameters.description: Set true to include the member count in the response (default false).

post.summary: Create a new public or private Slack channel. Names must use lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores only (
post.description: Create a new public or private Slack channel. Names must use lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores only (max 80 characters).

name.description: Desired name for the new channel.

is_private.description: Set true to create a private channel rather than a public one (default false).

team_id.description: Workspace ID, required only when using an org-level token.

post.summary: Add between 1 and 100 users to a public or private channel. The caller must already be a member of the channel.
post.description: Add between 1 and 100 users to a public or private channel. The caller must already be a member of the channel.

channel.description: ID of the channel to which users should be added.

users.description: Comma-separated list of user IDs to invite (up to 100).

force.description: When true and multiple users are supplied, continue inviting remaining users even if one fails.

post.summary: Archive a channel or DM to prevent any further messages from being posted. Not supported for all conversation types.
post.description: Archive a channel or DM to prevent any further messages from being posted. Not supported for all conversation types.

channel.description: ID of the conversation to archive.

post.summary: Set or replace the topic line shown at the top of a channel. The calling user must be a member of the conversation.
post.description: Set or replace the topic line shown at the top of a channel. The calling user must be a member of the conversation.

channel.description: ID of the conversation whose topic should be updated.

topic.description: New topic text. Formatting and link expansion are not supported.

get.summary: Get a paginated list of user IDs belonging to a conversation.
get.description: Get a paginated list of user IDs belonging to a conversation.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: ID of the conversation whose members should be listed.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum members per page (hard max 1000, recommended 200 or fewer).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor taken from response_metadata.next_cursor.

get.summary: Fetch previous messages and events from a channel or conversation. Results are returned newest-first.
get.description: Fetch previous messages and events from a channel or conversation. Results are returned newest-first.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: ID of the conversation to read history from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items to return (default 100, hard max 1000, recommended 200 or fewer).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor taken from response_metadata.next_cursor.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Retrieve only messages sent before this Unix timestamp (defaults to now).

parameters.name: oldest
parameters.description: Retrieve only messages sent after this Unix timestamp (defaults to 0).

parameters.name: inclusive
parameters.description: When true, messages at the exact oldest or latest boundary are included (default false).

get.summary: Retrieve all messages in a thread, including the original parent and all replies.
get.description: Retrieve all messages in a thread, including the original parent and all replies.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: ID of the conversation containing the thread.

parameters.name: ts
parameters.description: Timestamp of the parent message that starts the thread. Must match an existing message.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items per page (hard max 1000, recommended 200 or fewer).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor taken from response_metadata.next_cursor.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Only include messages before this Unix timestamp.

parameters.name: oldest
parameters.description: Only include messages after this Unix timestamp.

parameters.name: inclusive
parameters.description: When true, messages at the exact oldest or latest boundary are included (default false).

post.summary: Send a new message to a channel or direct message. Include thread_ts to post as a reply within an existing thread.
post.description: Send a new message to a channel or direct message. Include thread_ts to post as a reply within an existing thread.

channel.description: Destination channel, private group, or IM. Can be an encoded ID or a channel name.

text.description: Message body text. Required when no blocks or attachments are provided.

blocks.description: Structured Block Kit layout elements as a JSON array.

attachments.description: Legacy secondary message attachments as a JSON array.

thread_ts.description: Timestamp of another message; supply this to make the post a thread reply.

reply_broadcast.description: When used with thread_ts and set true, also posts the reply to the main channel (default false).

unfurl_links.description: Enables link preview expansion for text-based URLs (default false).

unfurl_media.description: Controls media URL expansion; set false to suppress it (default true).

mrkdwn.description: Set false to disable Slack's markdown-style text formatting (default true).

username.description: Override the bot's display name for this message (requires chat:write.customize scope).

icon_emoji.description: Emoji to display as the message icon (e.g. :chart_with_upwards_trend:).

icon_url.description: Image URL to use as the message icon.

post.summary: Change the text or block content of a previously posted message.
post.description: Change the text or block content of a previously posted message.

channel.description: Channel where the message to be changed was posted.

ts.description: Timestamp identifying the message to update.

text.description: Replacement text for the message. Required when blocks and attachments are not supplied.

blocks.description: Replacement Block Kit layout elements as a JSON array.

attachments.description: Replacement legacy attachments as a JSON array.

post.summary: Permanently remove a previously posted message from a channel.
post.description: Permanently remove a previously posted message from a channel.

channel.description: Channel containing the message to delete.

ts.description: Timestamp identifying the message to delete.

post.summary: Attach an emoji reaction to a message.
post.description: Attach an emoji reaction to a message.

channel.description: Channel where the target message was posted.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the message to react to.

name.description: Emoji name to use as the reaction, without surrounding colons (e.g. 'thumbsup').

get.summary: Retrieve all emoji reactions on a message.
get.description: Retrieve all emoji reactions on a message.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Channel where the target message was posted.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Timestamp of the message whose reactions to retrieve.

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: When true, returns the complete list of reacting users.

get.summary: Search across messages in the workspace matching a query. Supports in:channel and from:user modifier syntax.
get.description: Search across messages in the workspace matching a query. Supports in:channel and from:user modifier syntax.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search expression. Supports in:channel_name and from:user_id modifiers.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort matching messages by 'score' or 'timestamp' (default 'score').

parameters.name: sort_dir
parameters.description: Sort direction: 'asc' or 'desc' (default 'desc').

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Results per page (max 100, default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of results to return (default 1).

parameters.name: highlight
parameters.description: When true, matched terms are highlighted in the returned text.

get.summary: Enumerate all members of a Slack workspace. Useful for locating a user by display name or real name when their email or
get.description: Enumerate all members of a Slack workspace. Useful for locating a user by display name or real name when their email or ID is unknown.

get.summary: Look up a workspace member using their email address. Requires the users:read.email scope.
get.description: Look up a workspace member using their email address. Requires the users:read.email scope.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address of the workspace member to find.

get.summary: Retrieve the profile and account details for a single Slack user.
get.description: Retrieve the profile and account details for a single Slack user.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: ID of the user to look up.

parameters.name: include_locale
parameters.description: When true, the user's locale is included in the response (default false).

post.summary: Update profile fields for a user, such as status text and emoji.
post.description: Update profile fields for a user, such as status text and emoji.

profile.description: Object containing profile fields to update (e.g. status_text, status_emoji, status_expiration).

name.description: Name of a single profile field to set (alternative to supplying the full profile object).

value.description: Value to assign to the single profile field specified by name.

user.description: ID of the user whose profile to update (admin only). Defaults to the authenticated user.

post.summary: Open or resume a direct message or multi-person DM. Use this to obtain a DM channel ID before sending a message with cha
post.description: Open or resume a direct message or multi-person DM. Use this to obtain a DM channel ID before sending a message with chat.postMessage.

users.description: Comma-separated list of user IDs. A single ID opens a DM; multiple IDs open or resume an MPIM.

channel.description: ID of an existing IM or MPIM channel to resume.

return_im.description: When true, the response includes the full IM channel definition.

Channel.description: A Slack conversation, which may be a public channel, private group, DM, or multi-person IM.

id.description: Unique identifier for this conversation (e.g. C024BE91L).

name.description: Name of the channel, without the leading # symbol.

is_channel.description: True if this is a public channel.

is_group.description: True if this is a private channel.

is_im.description: True if this is a one-on-one direct message.

is_mpim.description: True if this is a multi-person direct message.

is_private.description: True if the conversation is private.

is_archived.description: True if the conversation has been archived.

is_member.description: True if the calling user belongs to this conversation.

num_members.description: Estimated count of members in this conversation.

created.description: Unix timestamp recording when this conversation was created.

creator.description: User ID of the person who created this conversation.

Message.description: A message posted in a Slack conversation.

ts.description: Timestamp that uniquely identifies this message within its channel.

user.description: User ID of the person who sent the message.

text.description: Plain text content of the message.

thread_ts.description: Timestamp of the parent message, present when this message is part of a thread.

reply_count.description: Total number of replies on this message (only set on thread parents).

reactions.description: Emoji reactions added to this message.

count.description: Total number of users who used this reaction.

users.description: IDs of the users who added this reaction.

User.description: A user account within a Slack workspace.
